snippet.title: Blightstone Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventurers, it’s time to join the fight. Blightstone releases today in Steam Early Access and we’re calling on you to join our heroes, destroy the Blightstone, and save the world.

Journey through our dark-fantasy land in a roguelite turn-based strategy. Unlock and upgrade heroes, master their unique skills and strategise to devastate the enemy.

As we begin on our journey through Early Access, the voices of our Adventurers are vital to how our tale evolves over time. Find us on X (Twitter), Bluesky and Tik Tok to join the conversation, meet fellow Adventurers, and discover new powers and strategies.

Buy NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832280/Blightstone/
X (Twitter): https://x.com/blightstonegame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/blightstonegame.bsky.social
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@blightstonegame
